card.name: Psychiatry and neurology contexts, linking words
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation right before a psychiatric or neurological term, such as 'with' or 'of' before schizophrenia, or 'chronic' before illness. Also seen in history-of-psychology passages naming theorists.

modes.label: Before schizophrenia
modes.description: A linking word such as 'with' or 'of' just before the word schizophrenia in study populations or criteria.
modes.example: Pooled data from the four placebo-controlled (one 9-week and three 13-week), fixed-dose studies in subjects<< with>> schizophrenia are presented in Table 5.
